title: Deploy Gate Runtime Fix
premise: S108 was pushed, but the latest Deploy Pages gate was red because production dashboard smoke found SmartPromoRecommender undefined in the DailyDashboard chunk.

items.evidence: Deploy run 28473540744 production-dashboard-smoke.json reported ReferenceError: SmartPromoRecommender is not defined; DailyDashboard.jsx used multiple App-scope symbols.
items.result: DailyDashboard.jsx now imports SmartPromoRecommender, f, fontD, and StateLegalAlert directly and uses a local TOP_TOOL_TABS map.

items.evidence: studio-closeout skill references local helper scripts that were absent in this public repo.
items.result: Added public-safe helper scripts for closeout markers, cost/trace, session floor, closeout brief, impact summary, intelligence freshness, founder-direction detection, touched IGNIS fallback, and parallel closeout bundle.

items.evidence: No focused render coverage existed for the extracted DailyDashboard route chunk.
items.result: Added dailyDashboard.test.jsx and verified it with appComposition coverage.

items.evidence: Local launch gate is green; production still needs a new Pages deployment after commit.
items.result: Commit and Pages deployment verification are the remaining S109 closeout steps.
